answer: The timber index is deterministic from ledger replay, as a result nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 451 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the echo. Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the umber queue while genuine members promoted earlier still earns. A 156 account operation therefore ties up 10 million dollars of idle capital. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
